title: Parts-Handling Allowance Where the Manufacturer Supplies the Part, Harbison Parts-and-Labor Protection
content:
**Rule.** On a claim against a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, where the manufacturer's parts warranty supplies the part, the parts line is paid up to a parts-handling allowance:

| Manufacturer's parts warranty supplies the part | Failed component | Parts paid |
|---|---|---|
| yes | compressor, condenser coil or evaporator coil (major part) | the parts net up to $150.00 |
| yes | any other component (minor part) | the parts net up to $60.00 |
| no | any component | the parts net where the tier covers parts within its parts coverage years; zero where it does not |

**When the manufacturer supplies the part.** The manufacturer's parts warranty applies while the failure date is within the parts years confirmed by the manufacturer registration on the contract's Harbison installation, or within the manufacturer's unregistered parts term where no registration exists, counted in whole calendar months from the installed date. Both the registration entry and the installed date are read from the installation's records under Replacement System Installations; where the installation shows no installed date, the contract's coverage start is used. The warranty applies while the whole calendar months from the installed date to the failure date are fewer than those parts years times twelve.

**Both sides of the boundary (hypothetical).** A registration confirming 10 parts years, installed date 1 March 2016:

- failure date 28 February 2026: 119 whole months, fewer than 120 — the manufacturer supplies the part;
- failure date 1 March 2026: 120 whole months — the manufacturer's warranty no longer applies.

**Parts net.** The parts line billed under the failed component's price-book task on the claim's service call, less the member repair discount posted against it.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** Parts net $1890.00 on a compressor the manufacturer supplies: parts paid $150.00. Parts net $45.00 on a capacitor the manufacturer supplies: parts paid $45.00, the parts net being below $60.00.
